change_summary: Release 2.14.0: UPI autopay mandates for subscriptions (NAV-4901), GST line fix on multi-pack receipts (NAV-4905). Pool tuning: DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS 30000 -> 5000 and node-postgres connectionTimeoutMillis 10000 -> 2000 to recycle idle connections faster.
Release 2.14.0: Celery 5.4 upgrade with kombu pinned (NAV-4925), homework-reminder digest mode (NAV-4928).
Release 2.14.0: JDBC batch inserts in ScoreWriter.persist() (NAV-4875), skill-level breakdown in teacher live report (NAV-4915), DLQ messages tagged with source partition and offset (NAV-4918).
Release 2.14.0: signer refuses keys expiring in < 24h and logs SigningKeyNearExpiry (NAV-4703), teacher 'view as student' impersonation audit trail (NAV-4910).
Hotfix: paygate:replay admin command accepts --to timestamps without seconds; no runtime behaviour change.
Raise SCORER_MAX_POLL_RECORDS default 200 -> 300; log item_bank_version at attempt start for scoring-mismatch triage.
MailRelay callback handler: accept new 'suppressed' event type instead of logging it as unknown.
Cap cardinality of client_ip label on auth_login_attempts_total (top 500 IPs, rest bucketed as 'other').
Add reason='unknown_event_type' to payments_api_webhook_events_total; return 200 for unknown PayGate event types.

Release 2.14.0 (retry of DEP-3296): CSV bulk item import with validation preview (NAV-4921), client-side guard for uploads above MEDIA_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (NAV-4932), fix for 5xx in /admin/reports/export (NAV-4945).
ETL: add schools_dim refresh task; MERGE on charge_id now covers refunds so warehouse.charges reflects refund status.
Pin kombu 5.4.2 ahead of Celery upgrade — post-sync 'celery inspect ping' failed (ImportError in kombu.transport.pyamqp); sync blocked, previous version kept.
Config: WAF rule auth-login-burst 100 -> 120 req/min/IP; AUTH_LOGIN_CAPTCHA_THRESHOLD 3 -> 5 after false positives at shared-IP schools.
PayGate SDK 4.2.1; plumb PAYGATE_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED through LaunchBoard flag payments.paygate_breaker.

Release 2.14.0: CSV bulk item import (NAV-4921), oversize upload guard (NAV-4932). Aborted by AnalysisTemplate nav-error-rate-slo: 3.4% 5xx on /admin/reports/export (export view used a removed queryset helper).
ETL: add attempt_scores.superseded_by to extract_scores and warehouse DDL — fixes ColumnNotFound in load_warehouse (NAV-4790).
Raise FCM_MAX_BATCH 250 -> 500; push worker CELERY_CONCURRENCY 12 -> 16.
Responses API rejects client retries that carry a new response_seq for an already-stored (attempt_id, item_id); prevents double-scoring on timeout retries.
Alembic: index on auth.audit_log(user_id, created_at); Cache-Control max-age=300 on /.well-known/jwks.json.
Receipt PDF rendering moved to notification-worker behind LaunchBoard flag payments.receipt_pdf_async (default off).
